modules.title: Introduction to Omenala (Culture and Customs)
modules.html:
Igbo marriage, naming ceremonies and the New Yam Festival. This section covers introduction to omenala (culture and customs).

Key points

  • Kedu dọkịta na-agwọ ọrịa site n'ịgwọ mkpọrọgwụ osisi n'omenala Igbo — Dibia ogwu.
  • Gịnị bụ 'Oji' n'omenala Igbo — Ihe nnọchiteanya nnabata na udo.

Worked examples

Q: Kedu dọkịta na-agwọ ọrịa site n'ịgwọ mkpọrọgwụ osisi n'omenala Igbo?
A: Dibia ogwu — A 'Dibia ogwu' is a traditional herbalist who uses roots and herbs for healing.

Q: Gịnị bụ 'Oji' n'omenala Igbo?
A: Ihe nnọchiteanya nnabata na udo — Kola nut (Oji) is the ultimate symbol of hospitality and peace in Igboland; 'He who brings kola brings life'.

examples.q: Kedu dọkịta na-agwọ ọrịa site n'ịgwọ mkpọrọgwụ osisi n'omenala Igbo?

quiz.q: Kedu dọkịta na-agwọ ọrịa site n'ịgwọ mkpọrọgwụ osisi n'omenala Igbo?
quiz.solution: A 'Dibia ogwu' is a traditional herbalist who uses roots and herbs for healing.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Oji' n'omenala Igbo?
options: Ihe e ji achụ àjà nani
Ihe e ji eri nri abalị
quiz.solution: Kola nut (Oji) is the ultimate symbol of hospitality and peace in Igboland; 'He who brings kola brings life'.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ myiriụda (Nasal consonant acting as a syllable)?
quiz.solution: 'm' and 'n' are nasal sounds that can sometimes carry a tone and form a syllable on their own in Igbo.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ mkpụrụasụsụ a kpọrọ 'Udaelu' (High tone syllable)?
quiz.solution: In standard Igbo orthography, high tones are typically left unmarked.

quiz.q: Gịnị ka a na-akpọ ememme a na-eme tupu e rie ji ọhụrụ?
quiz.solution: 'Ịwa ji' or 'Iri ji' is the festival celebrating the harvest of new yams.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Ikwa ozu' n'ala Igbo?
options: Ememme olili na ncheta onye nwụrụ anwụ
Iri nri n'ụlọ onye nwụrụ anwụ
quiz.solution: 'Ikwa ozu' refers to the second burial rites or the elaborate funeral ceremonies performed to honor the deceased.

quiz.q: Gịnị ka a na-eji amata onye nwere echichi 'Ozo' n'obodo?
options: Okpu mme mme na mpị nzu
quiz.solution: Symbols like the red cap (okpu mme mme), elephant tusk (mpị nzu), and ankle threads identify an Ozo titled man.

quiz.q: Gịnị ka a na-akpọ nwa mụrụ n'ụbọchị 'Afọ'?
quiz.solution: Depending on gender and dialect, names like Nwafor, Okafor, or Mgbafor all identify children born on Afọ day.

quiz.q: Asụsụ Igbo gụnyere 'Udamkpọ' (Vowel harmony). Gịnị ka ọ pụtara?
options: Udaume ịbịa n'ìgwè abụọ dị iche n'otu mkpụrụokwu
quiz.solution: Vowel harmony (udamkpọ) dictates that vowels from one set (Light/Heavy) do not usually mix with the other set in a word root.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'ụdaume mkpuchi' (Heavy vowels)?
quiz.solution: The heavy vowels (udaume mkpuchi/arọ) are e, i, o, and u.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Figure of Speech' maka 'Personification' n'Igbo?
quiz.solution: Nnyemmadụ (Personification) gives human qualities to non-human entities.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Ọmụgwọ'?
quiz.solution: Ọmụgwọ is the traditional postpartum care given to a new mother by her mother or a relative.

quiz.q: Onye bụ 'Diọpara'?
quiz.solution: The first-born son is called Diọpara (or Opwara).

quiz.q: 'Ije Odumodu Jere' bụ maka:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Njem.

quiz.q: Obodo 'Iri Ji' na-ewu:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Ala Igbo.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'King'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Eze.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Ten'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Iri.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Love'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Ịhụnanya.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Mmanwu'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Masquerade.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Ọkụ'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Fire/Light.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Uwe'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Clothes.

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'Suna' a cikin wannan jumlar: 'Musa ya tafi kasuwa'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Musa.

quiz.q: Menene 'Al'ada'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Culture/Tradition.

quiz.q: Wanne kayan kida ne Mamman Shata ke amfani da shi?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Kalangu.

quiz.q: Menene 'Kano Ta Dabo'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Kirarin Kano.

quiz.q: Kedu n'ime ndị a bụ ụdaume mịrị amị (Light vowels)?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: a, ị, ọ, ụ.

quiz.q: Kedu ka a na-akpọ 'House' n'Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ụlọ.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Market' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ahịa.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ njikọ (conjunction) n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Okwu na-ejikọ ahịrịokwu abụọ.

quiz.q: Kedu ihe 'Akụkọ ifo' (Folktale) na-ezi?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ezi omume.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Four'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Anọ.
